note: [LLM critic, high conf] The AI declares a 17% charge on a lone 4-wound Mek. The score is only +1.1 because ch_damage (+47.41) cancels ch_chance (-42.9), and the failure cost is not counted. Fix: Cap expected damage at the target's remaining wounds. Multiply the damage terms by the charge probability. Require a minimum score margin, or a minimum charge probability such as 40 percent, for a non-objective charge. Include the cost of a failed charge: the unit stays out of position and takes overwatch.
